nozzleOverlap.method: One global similarity using approximate visible outer-shroud upper fore/aft image features; no part-specific warp. Inspect upper band, petal edge, stabilator overlap and fuselage shoulder. No calibrated camera/state or dimensional conclusion.
nozzleOverlap.limitations: Photo47 crops the left nozzle edge and shows an unpowered aircraft with unknown actuator state. Current renderer uses existing dry game aperture; matching nozzle-command state is unproved. Off-axis perspective, stabilator chord and shoulder projection differ. External petal identity alone does not verify internal installed R35 structure or operating plume. Photos46-51 and composites remain private due copyright.
nozzleOverlap.observed: Composite generated and visually opened. Outer shroud line overlaps only approximately; opening ellipse, stabilator and fuselage shoulder disagree visibly. Do not infer a dimensional defect from this unmatched camera/state.
